criterion: which assistant-command intent the utterance expresses, that is what the user wants done

categories.name: Play Music
categories.definition: User wants to initiate playback of audio content.

categories.name: Add Music to Playlist
categories.definition: User wants to add a music item (song, artist, album) to a specified playlist.

categories.name: Rate Content
categories.definition: User wants to assign a rating or review to a piece of media or creative work.

categories.name: Get Weather Information
categories.definition: User wants to retrieve current or forecasted weather conditions for a location and/or time.

categories.name: Find Movie/TV Show Information
categories.definition: User wants to find details about movies or TV shows, including titles, schedules, showtimes, or where they are playing.

categories.name: Book Restaurant Reservation
categories.definition: User wants to make a reservation at a restaurant or similar dining establishment.

categories.name: Search for Information/Content
categories.definition: User wants to find information about or locate a specific item that is not music to play, a movie/TV show, or a restaurant reservation. This includes books, games, photographs, paintings, general creative works, products, or non-media schedules.
